result.question: What explanation did the old prophet give for the man of God's death?

readings.answer: Because he disobeyed the command of the LORD.
readings.support: disobeyed the command of the LORD

readings.answer: Because the LORD delivered him to the lion.
readings.support: Therefore the LORD has delivered him to the lion

readings.answer: It happened according to the word the LORD had spoken to him.
readings.support: according to the word that the LORD had spoken to him

readings.answer: He was mauled and killed by the lion.
readings.support: has mauled him and killed him

assessments.reason: It matches the stated cause in v.13:26 (“disobeyed the command of the LORD”), though it omits the added clause that the LORD delivered him to the lion.
It matches another part of the prophet’s explanation (“Therefore the LORD has delivered him to the lion”) but leaves out the stated cause of disobedience.
It cites a phrase the prophet includes as explanatory (“according to the word that the LORD had spoken to him”), though it does not mention the disobedience or the LORD delivering him to the lion.

It repeats the immediate means of death the prophet stated (“has mauled him and killed him”), which is part of the explanation given, though it omits the causal link to disobedience and the LORD’s judgment.
